The finding is submitted. Summary of the repair:

- **Kept the locked status** (deviation) and the preferred level, with no hybrid.
- **Op 1 (unchanged):** strikes the "three hundred percent (300%) of" multiplier in 7.9 so late payments accrue at the compensatory Subparagraph 7.8 rate.
- **Ops 2–3 (new):** cure the previously unmet preferred requirement in 23.2 by converting the two forfeiture limbs — no "payment or credit for the reclaimed capacity" and no "reimbursement of any amounts it had paid" — into pro-rata credit and pro-rata reimbursement for capacity not received. Both are operator/word-level edits within the same sentences; all other 23.2 language (extenuating circumstances, disposition, termination of rights, unpaid accounts, Schedule revision) is byte-for-byte intact.
- No defence duties, survival tails, damages categories, or early-termination-fee/fallback language were added, and the official minimality gate passed on all three replacements.
